name: pharma-bench-mlm
description: A masked-language-modeling (MLM) dataset focused on pharmaceutical text for evaluating domain-adapted language models. It is intended to measure masked token prediction performance and domain-specific language understanding for models pretrained or fine-tuned on biomedical/pharma corpora.
reputation: A small, domain-specific Hugging Face dataset used for pharmaceutical MLM experiments with limited but growing use among domain-adaptation researchers.
